text: Based on the evidence, most of the 2021 loss did occur inside the pine plantation. The total loss area was about 81.3 hectares. Of this, 68.1 hectares were within the planted forest area, specifically of Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda species. Only 13.2 hectares of the loss were outside the mapped forest areas. So, approximately 84% of the loss was inside the pine plantation.
